Embedding request via Google Vertex AI using the vertex_ai/ provider prefix and the text-embedding-005 model — response follows the standard OpenAI embeddings shape

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val request = mapper.readValue("{\"input\":\"Hello\",\"model\":\"vertex_ai/text-embedding-005\"}", EmbeddingRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.embed(request)
    println(result)
}

```
